Enable toggling the external signer flag on existing wallets instead of forcing immutable watch-only setups
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Substantive support across multiple reviewers with no open objections
Strong support for unblocking hybrid external signer and hot key multisig setups (PraneethGunas, rkrux)
Verified through Qt and CLI testing with mock signer and hardware device (adyshimony, naiyoma, PraneethGunas)
